propositions: BindingStore.unbind() conditionally removes reverse entries only when the forward entry contains a jira_key, causing orphaned reverse keys when the forward entry lacks jira_key or is removed via out-of-band routes
Merge conflicts and concurrent divergences in bindings.json can drop forward entries with no corresponding reverse cleanup, producing stranded reverse-index entries that persist indefinitely

rebar bridge fsck reports orphaned reverse keys as store_integrity faults but provides no supported public API to repair them, masking genuine integrity problems behind constant non-zero canary alerts
unbind() must be made self-contained by unconditionally removing both the forward entry and any residual reverse entries pointing to that local_id
A new rebar bridge fsck --repair command must safely prune orphaned reverse bindings with pre-write guards to ensure store validity and produce durable audit records
